<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1259673_intell_0.AIIncidentClassifier</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AIIncidentClassifier</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var AIIncidentClassifier = Class.create();
AIIncidentClassifier.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    classifyText: function(text, candidateLabelsArray) {
        // build candidate labels JSON string
        var labelsJson = JSON.stringify(candidateLabelsArray || ["Network", "Hardware", "Software", "Access", "Security", "Other"]);

        try {
            var rm = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2('Incident Classification API', 'POST');
            // set endpoint body directly (safe, no parameter substitution issues)
            var bodyObj = {
                inputs: text,
                parameters: {
                    candidate_labels: candidateLabelsArray,
                    multi_label: false
                }
            };
            rm.setRequestBody(JSON.stringify(bodyObj));

            // execute
            var response = rm.execute();
            var httpStatus = response.getStatusCode();
            var respBody = response.getBody();
            var parsed;
            try {
                parsed = JSON.parse(respBody);
            } catch (e) {
                parsed = {
                    error: 'invalid_json',
                    raw: respBody
                };
            }

            return {
                status: httpStatus,
                body: parsed
            };
        } catch (ex) {
            gs.error('AIIncidentClassifier.classifyText error: ' + ex);
            return {
                status: 500,
                error: ex.toString()
            };
        }
    },

    mapLabelToSN: function(label) {
        // Map label to ServiceNow sys_ids using ai_label_map table
        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_1259673_intell_0_ai_label_map');
        gr.addQuery('label_name', label);
        gr.query();
        if (gr.next()) {
            return {
                category_sys_id: gr.category_sys_id + '',
                subcategory: gr.subcategory + '',
                assignment_group_sys_id: gr.assignment_group_sys_id + ''
            };
        }
        return null;
    },

    type: 'AIIncidentClassifier'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-10-22 14:08:26</sys_created_on><sys_id>cac75df483743210a07896d6feaad3dd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AIIncidentClassifier</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Intelligent Task Assignment" source="x_1259673_intell_0">c568deec83203210a07896d6feaad304</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Intelligent Task Assignment">c568deec83203210a07896d6feaad304</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_cac75df483743210a07896d6feaad3dd</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-10-22 17:34:52</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
